description: This Java class defines a PlaylistItem that represents a media item with associated metadata and playback state tracking within the context of a media routing or media player application.

classes.name: PlaylistItem
classes.description: Represents a media playlist item with tracking of playback state, position, duration, and metadata such as session ID, item ID, URI, MIME type, and remote item ID.

methods.name: PlaylistItem
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a PlaylistItem with provided IDs, URI, MIME type, and PendingIntent. Sets timestamp to current elapsed realtime.

methods.name: setRemoteItemId
methods.description: Sets the remote item ID for the playlist item.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Updates the playback state of the item.

methods.name: setTimestamp
methods.description: Updates the timestamp to a specified value.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the URI of the media item.

methods.name: getUpdateReceiver
methods.description: Returns the PendingIntent used to update the media item.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Builds and returns a MediaItemStatus object representing the current state and progress of the media item.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the PlaylistItem, including IDs, state, and URI.
